decision: Do not suspend current verifier. Let all508 blocks complete naturally; prepare a strictly serial follow-on queue.

current --repo . alone is not proof of wrong ownership; unique process lineage and creation time were observed, but no control was attempted

scope: No process suspension, resumption, termination or verifier mutation
